pricing_documents.title: 2026 Standard Pricing Guide
pricing_documents.content: Fictional sample pricing: implementation packages range from USD 12,000 to USD 18,000. The standard subscription is USD 1,250 per month. Annual prepayment receives a 10 percent discount.

pricing_documents.title: Retail Proposal Pricing Example
pricing_documents.content: Fictional sample pricing: a retail analytics implementation is USD 15,000 with a USD 1,400 monthly subscription. Optional training is USD 2,000.

pricing_documents.title: Healthcare Services Pricing Example
pricing_documents.content: Fictional sample pricing: the healthcare onboarding package is USD 20,000 and the monthly subscription is USD 1,800. This example includes a 30-day implementation period.
